sources.snippet: EfficientDet is a one-stage detector built by the Google Brain team. Building upon EfficientNet and incorporating a novel bi-directional feature network and new scaling rules achieve high accuracy with fewer computation operations and is widely used in the production environment. sources.snippet: There are two types of latency: network latency and end-to-end latency. network latency: from the first conv op to the network class and box prediction. end-to-end latency: from image preprocessing, network, to the final postprocessing to generate a annotated new image.
